entries.1461dc923bd8ed2e: This business develops and operates location-based games. Its main service is Ekimemo! (Station Memories!), which features competition for railway stations, a lifelog element that records places actually visited, and a collection element for gathering stations and lines, and it has been operated for more than 10 years since its launch in 2014. It is distributed through SNS platforms and app marketplaces, and it earns revenue from paid billing. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥3,173 million.
